hook_line: US VISA CURBS PUSH IT JOBS TO INDIA

hook_stat.sub: Payment on H-1B petitions for workers outside the US

stats.label: Employers suspended from PERM green card sponsorship
Fall in new H-1B approvals for top seven Indian IT firms in fiscal 2025
US share of India's software and IT-enabled services exports

diaspora_bullets: Existing H-1B visas are not cancelled by either measure
PERM cases at the eight firms are frozen with no end date announced
news_summary: The US Labor Department suspended eight employers from PERM green card sponsorship on October 8, and H-1B petitions for workers outside the US carry a $100,000 payment.
payoff: Analysts say more of the work will be done from India instead of on site in the US.
